S01: Far away, in an ancient land beneath a grey sky, lived a boy whose name would change the destiny of the kingdom.
S02: In the workshop of the wizard Merlin, every day was a marvel.
S03: Merlin: "Come, boy. I will teach you the secrets of the world."
S04: In that workshop he learned incredible magical tricks.
S05: Sometimes he erred from youth, but Merlin was always there to set everything right.
S06: The years passed, and the boy grew into a strong and wise young man.
S07: Merlin: "It is time for you to live with a noble family and learn how to be a virtuous king."
S08: And so, Arthur went to live in the house of a nobleman.
S09: Kay: "I am Kay. If you are to live here, we shall be companions!"
S10: Arthur diligently performed every task: he groomed the horses.
S11: He cleaned the armor and sharpened the weapons until they gleamed.
S12: Still, he and Kay sometimes found time for play and talk.
S13: But one sad day, a dark word spread through the kingdom.
S14: King Uther died, and with that unrest began in the kingdom.
S15: The old king died without an heir all would recognize.
S16: The nobles gathered, each wanting the throne for himself.
S18: For the throne, fierce clashes began among the nobles.
S19: But there was an ancient legend of a magic sword.
S20: The magnificent Excalibur was thrust into a stone, awaiting the true king.
S21: Many tried to draw it out, but in vain.
S22: Not one of them was worthy.
S23: Then a group of powerful men organized a great tournament.
S24: Kay: "Arthur, come! Today I shall fight for the crown!"
S25: The two rode to the tournament, and excitement grew.
S26: Kay: "Arthur! I forgot my sword at home!"
S27: There was no time to fetch it, so Arthur at once began to look around for a sword.
S28: Suddenly, something gleamed among the trees — it was Excalibur.
S29: Some knight must have left it! — thought Arthur.
S30: As soon as he grasped the hilt, he felt something special.
S31: He pulled with all his strength, and the sword came out of the stone.
S32: Excalibur was free, shining in the sun.
S33: Arthur ran back and handed the sword to Kay.
S34: Kay: "Where did you get this... this? From where?"
S35: Arthur, without hesitation, pointed to the stone.
S36: A gasp of wonder spread among those present.
S37: The news that a boy had drawn Excalibur spread like fire.
S38: All wanted to see the sword with their own eyes.
S39: Noble: "But... he is only a shield-bearer!"
S40: Kay: "Let him show it! Let him draw it again before us!"
S41: Before the eyes of all, Arthur stood before the stone.
S42: He grasped the sword and pulled — once more it came out easily.
S43: Excalibur rose high, bright as the sun.
S44: Then he repeated it once more, and once more, without effort.
S45: Watching this, the doubts vanished and all bowed their heads.
S46: Arthur was proclaimed king of all that people.
S47: From that moment, the fights for the throne ceased.
S48: Peace finally returned to the kingdom, and the young king held Excalibur with honor.
